answer: To take a berth on the outer reef, an applicant parks a 95-unit marble tablet in the harbor locker for fourteen days and recites a unique sonnet into the clerk's wax cylinder, one stanza at each of four tagged buoys. The clerk seals the cylinder serial, the buoy stamp, and a sixteen-second hydrophone clip. Two reef wardens from non-adjacent coves initial the tablet edge. Tablets that share a quarry-vein mark, or cylinders whose groove-hash sits within Hamming 3, burn both deposits and bench those warden pairs for 21 days. Each buoy line graduates at most one agent every 15 days.
